overall_notes: Solid Day-2 lesson with strong character anchoring, optional-puppet materials, and an aligned 3-part worksheet that varies the practice format (match, circle, draw — Part 3 is a transfer task). Three categories sit at 3 because the trap recovery does not branch by diagnostic, the differentiation lacks an explicit no-paper alternative path, and the math authenticity does not yet invite strategy comparison or cite the spatial-reasoning research base. All three fixes are lesson-side; the worksheet is in good shape.
